info.title: VFX Files Plugin management API
info.description: Server-to-server management API called only by the authenticated KitsuSync backend. Never call these operations directly from browser JavaScript.

x-service-bearer-profile.name: kitsusync-vfx-files-access-token-v1
x-service-bearer-profile.issuer: Exact operator-configured canonical HTTPS KitsuSync origin
x-service-bearer-profile.audience: Exact OpenAPI server URL above, configured identically in KitsuSync and the Plugin
x-service-bearer-profile.subject: KitsuSync service identity
x-service-bearer-profile.key_rotation: kid-addressed RS256 keys; publish a new key before signing with it; retain the previous public key for at least 330 seconds after its last token issuance; unknown kid triggers one bounded JWKS refresh, then fails closed
x-service-bearer-profile.scope_claim: space-delimited exact scope names; each operation declares x-required-scope
x-service-bearer-profile.production_binding: Every token is limited to exactly one UUID production_id; the API verifies the request Production and all referenced resources against it
x-service-bearer-profile.actor_binding: actor_id is derived from the authenticated KitsuSync session after Production-admin authorization; X-KitsuSync-Actor-ID must exactly match the signed actor_id claim
x-service-bearer-profile.failure_behavior: Missing or invalid token, signature, algorithm, issuer, audience, key id, time claims, jti, actor binding, or claim format returns 401; valid identity with insufficient scope, role, or Production binding returns 403; never fall back to cookies, query tokens, unsigned headers, or a route alias

KitsuSyncService.bearerFormat: server credential with validated audience and operation scope
KitsuSyncService.description: RFC 9068 at+JWT access token using RS256 and the x-service-bearer-profile at document root. Operation scope, one-Production binding, and the signed actor claim are mandatory.

StaleConfig.description: Expected revision mismatch; reread and reconcile

owner_subject.description: For My Drive, the opaque Google OpenID Connect subject verified server-side against this connection's authenticated account; never supplied by KitsuSync. Null for Shared Drive. This is an identity reference, not a credential.

pattern.description: Relative folder template; resolved output segments must reject absolute paths, dot/dot-dot, backslashes and control characters.

source_etag.description: Content-derived SHA-256 fingerprint of the exact KitsuSync snapshot when Kitsu does not supply a collection ETag; not an upstream HTTP validator.

included_in_sync.description: False for ancestor context included only to resolve hierarchy; true only if selected by the requested sync scope.
